title: Pinokio App Registry Entry v1
description: Contract for a single Pinokio app entry in pmoves/configs/pinokio-apps/{curated,user}/<slug>.yaml. Per the slice-4 design, the entry declares the app's runtime facts, hardware contract, P8 surface, and network_exposure across the 4 reachability layers (L1 venv / L2 same-host container / L3 tailnet mesh / L4 public via kvm2 Cloudflare-Tunnel + hostinger.cloudflare.com DNS). Schema is additionalProperties:false at every level — drift is rejected at the validator. The metadata block is the only free-form escape hatch and is constrained to {string,number,boolean,null}.

schema_version.description: Semver of the schema this entry targets. Locks the contract version so a future v2 schema can reject v1 entries cleanly.

slug.description: Pinokio app directory name (e.g. comfyui-desktop). Matches the on-disk slug in ~/pinokio/api/<slug>/.

description.description: One-paragraph plain-text description of the app.

owner.description: Runtime owner of the app. pinokio = runs in the Pinokio venv on the host; docker / docker-compose = runs in a PMOVES container; nvidia / cloudflared / tailscale = system-level; pmoves = PMOVES-side synthetic entry.

version_seen.description: Version of the app as observed when the entry was last edited (e.g. 0.3.41). Free-form so launcher authors can use semver, calver, or their own scheme.

runtime.description: Runtime facts P7 needs at session-open + the bridge needs to launch. The venv manager is intentionally omitted — Pinokio 8 owns the Miniforge runtime (conda-forge-first, OSS-aligned).

launcher_script.description: Pinokio launcher script (e.g. start.js). The bridge calls pterm run --slug <slug> --script <launcher_script> via structured shell.run argv.

autostart.description: If true, P7 starts the app on room launch (subject to the 4-quadrant autostart × gpu_reservation_mode matrix in room.manifest.v1). If false, the app is on-demand only — the skill that needs it launches it.

gpu_required.description: Whether the app needs a GPU. Mirrors the room manifest's hardware_requirements.gpu for consistent routing.

min_vram_mb.description: Minimum VRAM in MB the app needs. 0 when gpu_required=false.

gpu_arch.description: Allowed GPU compute capabilities (NVIDIA sm_* + AMD gfx*). Empty array means any GPU is acceptable (when gpu_required=true) or no GPU is needed (when gpu_required=false).

gpu_reservation_mb.description: VRAM this app claims on the host. 0 when the app doesn't reserve (e.g. CPU-only, gpu_required=false).

gpu_reservation_mode.description: How the VRAM claim interacts with other concurrent refs. concurrent = shares the host GPU (counts toward the host's concurrent sum); exclusive = claims the whole host GPU (P7 rejects rooms that mix auto-launched exclusive + auto-launched concurrent refs).

dependencies.description: Intra-node launch order: which other Pinokio apps must be ready before this one starts. Recursive (per Pinokio 8 orchestration). Cross-node orchestration stays with P7.

requires_hf_login.description: If true, the launch wrapper calls Pinokio 8's hf.login device-auth before starting the app. The native login modal handles the user interaction; the wrapper just gates the start on success.

endpoints.description: How to reach the app. primary is the main HTTP/WS surface; alt is for additional service ports (e.g. a metrics endpoint).

port.description: TCP port the app listens on. 0 = dynamic (Pinokio assigns at runtime; the actual port is resolved via the bridge's /v1/apps/{slug}/status).

health.description: Path the mesh/PMOVES polls to check app health (e.g. /gradio_api/info, /healthz). null = no health endpoint.

pinokio_skill_ref.description: Slug of the P8 managed skill that covers this app, or null if the app is a raw Pinokio app (not a managed skill). The bridge's /v1/skills endpoint mirrors P8's managed-skills library.

network_exposure.description: 4-level ladder (operator-approved Q1). Per-layer reachability contract. L1+L2 are host-local; L3 is the tailnet mesh; L4 is the public website via kvm2 Cloudflare-Tunnel + hostinger.cloudflare.com DNS.

l1_venv.description: Same-host, same-process space: apps call each other in the Pinokio venv graph.

l2_container_same_host.description: PMOVES container on the same host as the Pinokio venv. Talks via host.docker.internal:<port>.

address.description: Concrete address when reachable. Convention: http://host.docker.internal:<port>.

l3_mesh.description: Other host on the headscale tailnet. Talks via <slug>.<tailscale_host>.ts.pmoves.net:<port>. WireGuard-encrypted. ACL gates which ports each group can reach.

headscale_acl_ports.description: Ports the mesh_exposure service adds to pmoves/config/headscale/acl.yaml so other groups can reach the app over the mesh.

tags_required.description: Tags a client must have to reach the app (per headscale ACL). Empty = any group.

l4_public.description: Public website via kvm2's Cloudflare-Tunnel + Tailscale-Funnel + hostinger.cloudflare.com DNS. The mesh_exposure service (slice 4) reconciles this end-to-end.

tunnel.description: kvm2 Cloudflare-Tunnel name (e.g. pmoves-edge). The mesh_exposure service creates/updates the tunnel ingress entry to point at the L3 mesh endpoint.

dns_record.description: Hostinger / Cloudflare-managed DNS record (e.g. comfyui.pmoves.ai). The mesh_exposure service ensures the CNAME points at the tunnel.

public_url.description: Public URL end users hit (e.g. https://comfyui.pmoves.ai).

notes.description: Free-form notes (operator commentary, history, follow-ups). Each note is a single line.

metadata.description: Free-form escape hatch for app-specific knobs that don't fit the schema. Constrained to scalar values so YAML stays diffable.
